structureDescriptions.learningPaths: Manage top-level training frameworks and career tracks (e.g., Jornada Técnica, Power Skills). Use this section to create and structure the global educational journeys that contain corporate Service Lines.
structureDescriptions.serviceLines: Segment your Learning Paths into main operational divisions and technology pillars (e.g., Hybrid Cloud, Application Operations). Use this to organize and group specialized business units.
structureDescriptions.areas: Define specific technology frameworks, platforms, and fields of expertise (e.g., LowCode OutSystems, DevOps). Each Area must host its own mandatory career progression milestones.
structureDescriptions.stages: Configure the sequential advancement tiers (Junior to Knowledge Leader) within each Area. Use this card to bind unique digital badges and set up the external training requirements.
